assessments.reasoning: The questionnaire records hours worked in paid economic activities in Sección H (question h3a: 'Habitualmente, ¿cuántas horas y días trabaja a la semana?'). However, it does not collect time allocation for unpaid domestic or care work, leisure, or self-care. Per the indicator rule, if the instrument only records hours of paid work with no time recorded for any other daily activity, all four statements are false.
